item.title: Literature Brief (November 11, 2026)
item.description: GNPS2-Quant connects non-targeted discovery with scheduled targeted quantification, while the reported comparison cautions against assuming that targeted acquisition always improves sensitivity. / GNPS2-Quant将非靶向发现衔接到定时靶向定量，研究中的比较也提醒我们，不应假定靶向采集总能提高灵敏度。

item.title: Literature Brief (November 10, 2026)
item.description: Joint cell and protein representations connect single-cell proteomic heterogeneity with protein-module recovery, while interpretation remains dependent on preprocessing and biological priors. / 细胞与蛋白的联合表征将单细胞蛋白组异质性分析与蛋白模块恢复联系起来，其解释仍依赖预处理和生物学先验。

item.title: Literature Brief (November 7, 2026)
item.description: Network-guided metabolomics, peptide-language-model priors and standardized glycoproteomics deposition connect computational interpretation with reusable evidence. This brief distinguishes candidate prioritization from confirmed identification and repository infrastructure from analysis quality. / 网络引导代谢组解读、肽语言模型先验与标准化糖蛋白组数据提交，将计算解释与可复用证据连接起来。本期区分候选排序与确定性鉴定，以及数据基础设施与分析质量。

item.title: Literature Brief (November 6, 2026)
item.description: Predicted fragment intensities can make real-time peptide searching more efficient, while integrated metabolomics resources can support traceable data reuse. This brief examines Comet's Carafe-assisted index and the Met-SC platform, with explicit limits on accuracy and validation claims. / 预测碎片强度可提高实时肽段检索效率，整合代谢组资源则有助于可追溯的数据复用。本期关注Comet的Carafe辅助索引与Met-SC平台，并明确区分效率、资源规模与准确性验证。

item.title: Literature Brief (November 5, 2026)
item.description: Molecular neighborhoods, intact masses and retention times provide complementary evidence for distinguishing mass-spectrometry candidates. This brief covers neighborhood-guided metabolite structure inference, large-proteoform identification, the limits of retention-time models, and traceable agent-assisted top-down proteomics. / 分子邻域、完整质量和保留时间为质谱候选判别提供互补证据。本期关注邻域约束的代谢物结构推断、大蛋白质型鉴定、保留时间模型的适用边界，以及可追溯的自上而下蛋白组智能体分析。

item.title: Literature Brief (November 4, 2026)
item.description: Spectral structure elucidation and quality control both need inspectable evidence. This brief examines the limits of LLMs assisted by specialist tools, diagnostic reporters in molecular networks, and reproducible DIA quality checks. / 谱图结构解析与质量控制都需要可核查的证据。本期关注LLM借助专业工具的能力边界、分子网络中的诊断碎片识别，以及可重复的DIA质量检查。

item.title: Literature Brief (November 3, 2026)
item.description: Differential HDX-MS connects protein conformational populations with experimental exchange signals. This method jointly models structural ensembles across states and shared deuterium loss, offering an interpretation strategy when loss-correction controls are unavailable. / 差异 HDX-MS 可连接蛋白构象群体与实验交换信号。本期方法把多个状态的结构集合和共同氘损失联合建模，为缺少损失校正对照的数据提供结构解释思路。

item.title: Literature Brief (November 2, 2026)
item.description: Two approaches examine competing interpretations: challenging non-reference peptide sequences with canonical alternatives, and reranking small-molecule structures through a multi-agent framework. Both compare candidates, while statistical validation must remain distinct from model output. / 本期关注两类候选判别：用常规肽段检验非参考序列的独特性，以及用多智能体框架重排小分子结构候选。二者都强调候选之间的比较，但统计验证仍需与模型输出分开。

item.title: Literature Brief (November 1, 2026)
item.description: Today’s focus is metabolite-candidate prioritization in mass spectrometry imaging: combining spatial image similarity with chemical relationships to guide follow-up while distinguishing ranked candidates from definitive structural identification. / 今天关注质谱成像的代谢物候选排序：将空间图像相似性与化学关系作为先验，帮助决定后续验证对象，同时区分候选优先级与确定性结构鉴定。

item.title: Literature Brief (October 31, 2026)
item.description: From rule-based GC–MS classification to adaptive follow-up measurements and differential-interaction prediction, these papers examine how mass-spectrometry evidence informs decisions while keeping simulation, classification and biological inference distinct. / 从 GC–MS 规则基线到自适应补充测量，再到蛋白相互作用变化预测，今天关注如何把质谱证据转化为可检验的决策，并保留模拟、分类和生物推断之间的边界。

item.title: Literature Brief (October 30, 2026)
item.description: Peptide identification and immunogenicity prediction require distinct layers of evidence. Today’s paper connects mass-spectrometry searching, transcriptomics and candidate prioritization, with an emphasis on reuse and validation limits. / 免疫肽鉴定与免疫原性预测需要区分不同层次的证据。今天介绍一个连接质谱检索、转录组和候选肽优先级的流程，关注其可复用性与验证边界。

item.title: Literature Brief (October 29, 2026)
item.description: Today’s papers address interoperability in mass spectrometry imaging and the limits of transferring computational methods between proteomics and metabolomics. Shared data representations can reduce integration work, while identification confidence and quantification still depend on each field’s evidence structure. / 今天聚焦质谱成像的数据互操作，以及蛋白组与代谢组计算方法迁移的边界：统一数据表示可以减少软件适配成本，但鉴定置信度与定量策略仍需服从各自的证据结构。

item.title: Literature Brief (October 28, 2026)
item.description: Cross-gradient LC-HRMS feature correspondence and cross-fragmentation spectral-library matching. / 跨梯度 LC-HRMS 特征对应与跨碎裂方式谱库匹配。

item.title: October 27, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Diagnostic-ion validation for glycopeptide searches, ambiguity-aware spatial pathways, and scalable mass spectrometry imaging. / 糖肽搜索的诊断离子验证、保留注释歧义的空间通路分析与大规模质谱成像计算。

item.title: Literature Brief — October 26, 2026
item.description: Topographic correction in 3D ToF-SIMS and transformation-guided metabolite annotation. / 三维 ToF-SIMS 形貌校正与转化规则驱动的代谢物注释。

item.title: Literature briefing: 25 October 2026
item.description: A benchmark examines how DIA search and quantitative-analysis choices interact, emphasizing accuracy and false-discovery control alongside identification depth. / DIA 搜索与定量分析的组合评测，把倍数变化准确性和假发现率控制与鉴定深度放在同一评价框架中。

item.title: October 24, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Reusable workflows for spatial proteomics, protein isoforms and cross-link-guided structural modeling. / 聚焦空间蛋白组、蛋白异构体及交联约束结构建模的可复用流程。

item.title: October 23, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: New spatial-proteomics and DIA workflow reports are visible, but their verification is incomplete. / 出现空间蛋白组与DIA流程新报告，但论文信息核验尚不完整。

item.title: October 22, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Benchmark design, proteomics outlier detection and reusable metabolomics integration. / 聚焦评测划分偏差、蛋白组异常检测与公共代谢组数据整合。

item.title: October 21, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: No additional computational mass spectrometry papers selected today. / 今天暂未选出新的质谱计算方法论文。

item.title: October 20, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Auditable omics reanalysis, single-cell graph clustering and local metabolomics workflows. / 可审计组学重分析、单细胞图聚类与本地代谢组工作流。

item.title: October 19, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: No additional computational mass spectrometry papers selected today. / 今天暂未选出新的质谱计算方法论文。

item.title: October 18, 2026 Literature Brief
item.description: Spectrum representations, spatial associations and uncertainty-aware analysis across proteomics and metabolomics. / 关注谱图表征、空间关联，以及蛋白组和代谢组分析中的不确定性。

item.title: Literature digest · October 17, 2026
item.description: Today's papers examine spectral evidence for de novo candidate reranking and stricter validation of retention-time prediction. / 本日关注两种提高预测可信度的思路：以谱图证据重排从头测序候选，以及用严格的数据划分检验保留时间模型。

item.title: Literature digest · October 16, 2026
item.description: This edition focuses on continuous QC for large proteomics cohorts, quantitative benchmarks with defined microbial communities, and interactive downstream analysis. / 本期关注大规模蛋白组的持续质控、已知微生物群落的定量基准，以及交互式下游分析。

item.title: Literature digest · October 15, 2026
item.description: Today’s papers address reusable training data for proteomics and integrated analysis of mass cytometry. / 今天关注蛋白质组学训练数据的可复用性，以及质谱流式分析的统一工作流。

item.title: Literature digest · October 14, 2026
item.description: Today’s papers connect small-molecule spectral prediction, mobility-resolved peptide identification and transferable single-cell statistics. / 今天关注小分子谱图预测、离子淌度肽段鉴定，以及可借鉴的单细胞统计方法。

item.title: Literature digest · October 13, 2026
item.description: Today’s focus is an LC–HRMS workflow connecting signal extraction, feature construction and putative metabolite annotation. / 今天关注将信号提取、特征构建与代谢物暂定注释连接起来的 LC–HRMS 软件。

item.title: Literature digest · October 12, 2026
item.description: Seven recent publications cover peptide mapping, modified-RNA annotation, reproducible metabolomics, ion-mobility imaging and multi-omics tools. / 七篇近期文献，聚焦肽段映射、修饰 RNA 注释、可复现代谢组分析、淌度成像及多组学工具。

item.title: Literature digest · October 11, 2026
item.description: Seven recent papers cover isotope prediction, structural modeling, formula and polymer-composition analysis, biologics data interpretation and acquisition integration. / 本日精选七篇近期方法文献，涵盖同位素预测、结构建模、分子式与聚合物组成辨识、生物药数据分析及采集集成。

item.title: Literature digest · October 10, 2026
item.description: Four recent papers examine proteomic representation learning, isotope-tracing feature pairing, DIA quantification benchmarks and isotope-guided metabolite discovery. / 四篇近期文献，关注蛋白质组表征学习、同位素示踪特征配对、DIA 定量基准与同位素引导的代谢物发现。

item.description: Four recent papers on retention-time prediction, spectral representation learning, targeted MRM and proteomics analysis. / 四篇近期方法文献，涵盖保留时间预测、谱图表征学习、靶向 MRM 与蛋白质组学分析。
